mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 3% YoY signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 > 3% YoY growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during FEDFUNDS < 0.5% periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 6%) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between UNRATE and SPX 5-day returns remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when both Industrial Production (INDPRO) and Housing Starts (HOUST) show YoY growth above 5%, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances with both INDPRO and HOUST > 5% YoY growth.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: during post-shock recovery, a rise in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by > 1% MoM signals positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns during post-shock RSAFS > 1% MoM periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is inversely associated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and SPX 20-day returns remains below -0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: a > 0.5% increase in Nonfarm Payroll Employment (PAYEMS) in a single month signals positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of months with PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM growth.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when Industrial Production (INDPRO) shows YoY decline > 2% and simultaneously Housing Starts (HOUST) show YoY growth < 3%, S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 45% of instances with INDPRO < -2% YoY and HOUST < 3% YoY.
